help.goal: Be the first to empty your rack by laying your tiles into valid runs and groups.
steps: Tap 3 or more rack tiles, then tap Lay as set.
Tap a single tile, then add to set 2 to extend a table set.
Tap sort: colors to flip your rack between colour and 1→13 order.
Tap Undo to pull staged tiles back to your rack.
Tap End turn to commit, or Draw to take a tile and pass.
notes: Your first play must be new sets of your own worth 30 points or more, with nothing added to the table.
Jokers stand in for any tile. One left on your rack at the end counts 30 against you.
Tap Rearrange table to rebuild the whole table: every set must end up valid, and at least one tile must come from your rack.
